scope.included: Static runtime call-site audit of non-Faron speech triggers, resolver fallbacks, and repeated generic Roshan cues.
scope.method: rg line inventory plus resolver/file-existence checks; counts are static call-site counts, not a claim about one playthrough's event frequency. Multiline calls are listed by their opening line.

resolution_order: assets/audio/voices/filler_v1/<speaker>.ogg (only when event is non-empty and speaker is not protected)
assets/audio/voices/filler_v1/yay.ogg via play_success_yay, where explicitly called
VOICE_PITCH fallback on ReefMain.voice when no path resolves
important_findings: filler_v1/roshan_talk.ogg and filler_v1/roshan_win.ogg exist, so generic Roshan talk/win calls do not fail closed; they repeatedly play one generic recording.
The fallback pitch tint is scripts/main.gd:3843 (Roshan 1.18), but it is bypassed whenever an exact filler or legacy path exists; changing pitch alone cannot diversify exact cues.
_speaker_key() defaults unknown labels to roshan at scripts/audio_director.gd:190, so environment labels can masquerade as Roshan and inherit her generic voice.
show_msg() additionally emits a second Roshan talk call at several Castle day-one sites after a Daddy/Baby Eagle hint, creating a generic extra cue for one action.

static_summary.unknown_environment_label_count_basis: Literal show_msg labels in scripts with no matching _speaker_key branch; multiline calls counted by opening line.

high_frequency_runtime_contexts.context: Castle prop actions and room activation
Cleaning, craft, grotto, collection, companion and general interaction

repetition_clusters.action: Replace by semantic trigger, keeping one cue per event and using the existing text/pointer as the source for each exact recording brief. Do not globally alias these IDs back to roshan_talk.

high_frequency_runtime_contexts.context: Combat, dungeon, picture games and kart success

repetition_clusters.action: Reserve roshan_win for a generic optional celebration only; bind success text and action identity to separate exact cues so repeated wins do not sound identical.

binding_gaps.trigger: Entering any announced Castle room except the rescued-playroom branch.
binding_gaps.current_resolution: _speaker_key("Pearl Castle") -> roshan; roshan_home has no filler/legacy asset, so this falls through to yay fallback.
brief_examples: The pool is making sparkly waves!

binding_gaps.trigger: Crown Star award in the Royal Hall.
binding_gaps.current_resolution: Unknown label falls through to Roshan and resolves to generic roshan_win.
brief_examples: The Crown Star is ours! Every room is ready for exploring!

binding_gaps.trigger: Music Room start, listen/echo round, success, next round and retry.
binding_gaps.current_resolution: Music Room is not a speaker key, so default routing uses Roshan; default calls reuse roshan_talk, while win/oops reuse generic Roshan events.

binding_gaps.trigger: Rainbow Road destinations, Ocean Race return, Butterfly World return and Ember Fortress return.
binding_gaps.current_resolution: Rainbow Road, Ocean Race, Butterfly World and Ember Fortress are not speaker keys; generic/default calls route to Roshan and often roshan_talk.

binding_gaps.trigger: Bubble-lift floor arrival and Opera venue opening.
binding_gaps.current_resolution: Pearl Opera House is unknown and routes to Roshan; Chapter Two additionally follows its show_msg(home) with _say(roshan,talk) at scripts/main.gd:3422.

binding_gaps.trigger: Blocked/resting Castle door, day-one cleanup gate, rescued-stuffie gate and newly glowing door.
binding_gaps.current_call: A Daddy Mermaid or Baby Eagle hint is followed by _say("roshan", "talk").
binding_gaps.current_resolution: The contextual speaker line is accompanied by an unrelated generic Roshan talk recording; the same clip repeats across all gate states.
binding_gaps.action: Use a single intentionally authored speaker/cue for each state, or omit the extra Roshan call when the contextual Daddy/Baby Eagle cue is the owner-approved voice.

binding_gaps.trigger: Kitchen recipe chooser opens and displays its pointer.
binding_gaps.current_resolution: A bare _say(roshan,talk) plays with no semantic text or exact recipe context.

non_faron_protection_note: This report does not recommend editing, replacing, or regenerating any Faron or protected family recording. New IDs are recording briefs/routing targets only; they require owner-authorized child voice acting and separate listening acceptance.
